parameter_semantics: phase is semantic intent inferred from observed physical relationships, not elapsed time. drawer_clear uses a fixed world anchor for gripper release and high drawer retreat; red_acquire uses current observed red SE(3); red_place_release uses current observed red_goal translation with world axes; bridge_to_blue uses the newest causal TCP SE(3); blue_acquire uses current observed blue SE(3). primary_object, destination and successor_object are closed selectors for red_pose, red_goal and blue_pose. Poses use world metres and wxyz quaternions.
output_semantics: Each slot is [x,y,z,r1x,r1y,r1z,r2x,r2y,r2z,gripper]. XYZ is TCP target translation in metres and the two 3-vectors are the first two target-rotation columns, all expressed in the phase-selected anchor frozen from the newest causal observation for the chunk. drawer_clear uses world; red_acquire uses red SE(3); red_place_release uses a red_goal-origin/world-axis frame; bridge_to_blue uses chunk-start TCP SE(3); blue_acquire uses blue SE(3). The decoder Gram-Schmidt projects rotation 6D, composes anchor*relative_target into a world TCP pose, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints. Gripper preserves the demonstrated scalar and common nonnegative=open, negative=close semantics. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; slots 1 through 8 execute from current t.

conversion_check.description: Encode FK of each demonstrated joint command as inverse(causal phase anchor) times commanded world TCP; decode by exact anchor composition, safe 6D Gram-Schmidt, and verified Panda IK from measured joints. Compare FK TCP position in metres, rotation angle in radians, and gripper scalar; nonunique joint solutions are judged in task space.

cut_relation: Five contiguous bindings per demonstration cover [230,320), [320,500), [500,650), [650,700), and [700,850), so every assigned [230,850) action is supervised exactly once. Complete [230,470) action overlap with open_drawer and [600,850) action overlap with blue_insert is retained.
